headline: Giants Confirm Brian Burns Suffered ACL Tear

headline: Giants acquire JJ McCarthy from Vikings
summary: McCarthy is headed to New York in exchange for a 2027 fifth-round pick and will initially back up Jameis Winston.

headline: Buccaneers' Mayfield (thumb) out at least three weeks, Bowles says
summary: Buccaneers quarterback Baker Mayfield is expected to miss at least three weeks with the dislocated thumb on his throwing hand he suffered Sunday, coach Todd Bowles announced Monday.

headline: Sources: Jets RB Breece Hall week-to-week with quad injury
summary: Jets running back Breece Hall, who suffered a quad injury in Sunday's 31-24 loss to the Lions, is considered week-to-week, sources told NFL Network's Ian Rapoport and ESPN's Adam Schefter.

headline: Ravens expect centers Jovaughn Gwyn, Ethan Pocic to miss extended time
summary: The Ravens saw two centers leave Sunday's win over the Cowboys with injuries and head coach Jesse Minter said on Monday that they don't expect to have either one of them back in the lineup for quite a while.

headline: Sources: Vikings' Jefferson has ankle sprain, could play this week
summary: Vikings star wide receiver Justin Jefferson has an ankle sprain, according to the MRI performed Monday, and there's a chance he'll be able to play Sunday against the Dolphins, sources told NFL Network's Ian Rapoport and ESPN's Dan Graziano.
